claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft is scheduled to splash down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft is scheduled to splash down around 5:07 p.m. PDT (8:07 p.m. EDT).
The Artemis II crew will be recovered by the U.S. Navy ship USS John P. Murtha.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft will use parachutes to slow down.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft will use an airbag system to upright itself in the water.
